title: Riverview Luxury Condo: Garage, Balcony, Downtown
description:
Stunning Riverfront condo with 2 private balconies. Walk to Downtown Broadway Bars, Germantown and lots of restaurants, bars and coffee shops. Free parking spot in a gated garage connected to the building.  Enjoy your morning coffee on 2 of our private balconies, one that overlooks the Cumberland River. Washer/Dryer in the unit + TVs in the living room and all bedrooms. Walk to Brooklyn Bowl, Sounds Baseball Stadium, Ryman, Nissan Stadium (home of the Titans), Country Music Hall of Fame + more!

The space
HIGHLIGHTS

★ 3 Bedrooms
★ 2.5 Bathrooms
★ 2 Kings, 2 Twin Beds, 1 Queen Sofa Bed
★ Overlooks the Cumberland River
★ Walk to Downtown Nashville & Broadway Bars
★ Dedicated Parking for 1 car in a gated garage, plus additional guest parking available (first come, first serve)
★ Smart TVs in the living room and all 3 bedrooms
★ Desk to work from in bedroom 2
★ Mirror + Station to get ready at in bedroom 1
★ 2 Private Balconies with outdoor furniture
★ High-speed wifi
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Dining table with seating for 4, plus additional high-top table with seating for 4
★ Tons of natural light
★ Washer/Dryer in the condo 
★ Coffee maker and coffee provided
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Located next to Germantown neighborhood - a popular area with great restaurants, coffee shops and shopping
★ Right next to Sound Baseball Stadium & Brooklyn Bowl (see some great music concerts)
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Ample closet storage space for your clothes & other items
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Secure building with key code entry
★ Elevator in the building
★ Sound machines in the bedrooms

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King Bed + balcony
Bedroom 2: King Bed + ensuite bath
Bedroom 3: Two Twin Beds
Living Room: Queen Sofa Bed

BATHROOMS:
Bathroom 1: Full size in the hallway
Bathroom 2:  Full size connected to bedroom #2
Bathroom 3: Half bath in the hallway

This condo is one of Nashville's gems, and it's nearly impossible to find anything as well appointed, close to town, and comfortably furnished as this condo. If you want a memorable, tranquil space that is within walking distance to all the attractions in Downtown Nashville, then this is the home for you. Step out of the home and you're a short half mile walk to Broadway, where there are many restaurants and Honky Tonks with live music every night. Walk to Bridgestone Arena only 0.7 mi, the Music City Hall of Fame is just a 0.8 mi walk. Even the world-renowned Ryman Auditorium (the original Grand Ole Opry) is a short 0.6 mi. walk from the condo! We're also near Nissan Stadium (home of the Tennessee Titans), Ascend Amphitheater, Brooklyn Bowl and First Tennessee Park where the Sounds (minor league baseball team) play. You can't beat this location.

Our condo boasts natural, inviting furnishings to make you feel at home and at ease. Professionally cleaned and designed, all aspects have been thoughtfully put together with your comfort & convenience in mind. High-quality mattresses + bedding, tasteful details incorporated throughout, modern amenities and plenty of space. This condo will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville. You can’t beat this location - walking distance to so many things!

Walk To (alphabetical order):

- Ascend Amphitheater
- Bicentennial Park
- Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
- Brooklyn Bowl Music Venue
- Country Music Hall of Fame
- Country Music Television (CMT)
- Farmers Market
- Germantown
- Hard Rock
- Honky Tonks
- Music City Center (Convention Center)
- Printer’s Alley
- Restaurants such as Jonathan’s, Merchants, Jeff Ruby’s, Puckett's, Morton's, The Southern Steak & Oyster, Wildhorse Saloon and numerous others!
- Ryman Auditorium
- Schermerhorn Symphony
- Sounds Minor League Baseball Stadium
- Tennessee Performing Arts Center (TPAC)
- Titans Stadium

Permit two zero two one zero five six one four zero

Guest access
You will have the entire condo to yourself.

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.

All pets must be approved by us in advance of your booking.

Please note that this is a city condo and Nashville is growing quickly! There may be some construction noise around the area. Also, there is an active train line next door that does make noise when passing. It's fun to watch and we do provide sound machines for light sleepers.

We have one dedicated parking space in the garage. Additional parking is first come, first serve.
